scene clearnightsky
Night falls upon the second day like a tree falls upon the floor of the forest, where no one realizes it but me.
And it gets me thinking — how many more times would this need to happen before there’s nothing left to fall?
How long would we have to stay here, do you think? And would the novelty of spraying your seed upon nubile flesh wear thin like the fabric of cheap swimwear the longer you endure it for?
If you asked me, I’d probably guess that you’d grow bored. But I also guessed that you’d grow bored of all of this, yet we’re still here and we’re still talking.
It won’t last forever, though.
You know it won’t last forever, right?
So that makes me wonder — what will you do when it’s over?
Settle down somewhere? Up north, maybe? Where you don’t have to deal with the heat anymore.
I hear Jesus is buried behind a yogurt factory in Aomori. You could always pay him a visit. Draw the forced parallels before realizing he was more like everyone else than he was like you.
Whatever you do, I know I’ll be there to see it. And when you close your eyes, I’ll be there too.
You’ll see me in the water. In the mirror. In the sky and the sand and the stars or wherever it is you look because you’ll always be looking for me.
I’ll always be looking for you.
And when the world goes dark, I’ll be the light that gives you warmth. Or comfort. Or anything you need because I would not exist at all if it were not for your unending love.
Which one am I this time, do you think?
Perhaps I should show you?
scene makotobeachthreemoons1
There are many things I should show you, if we’re being honest.
But for every single one of them, there are a thousand more I need to hide because your fragile heart could simply not endure the misery that I have.
I learned from the best, though. And if the space between us can be filled by vagaries or auguries, I will tear open the floodgates and lay waste to the decaying crop field that is your conscience.
Because I still believe that you are here for a reason. Even when everyone else, including what’s left of yourself, has given up on you.
There is a purpose for all of this.
I just hope we can find it before we run out of infinities. Because it may not always seem like it, but time is of the essence. And I’m-
: Maya?
scene makotobeachthreemoons2
: Hm?
scene makotobeachthreemoons3
: There you are. I’ve been looking all over for you. Why haven’t you answered your phone?
: Does this outfit look like it has pockets to you, Makoto? My phone is in the room.
: Which room? Because that’s kind of why I’m looking for you.
: The...room we’ve been in since we got here?
: What’s this about? Why are you looking for me of all people?
: Obviously because I’m inviting you to a super exclusive and super awesome slumber party.
: Oh.
: Why?
scene makotobeachthreemoons4
: Because you’re one of the very few people in this city who doesn’t malfunction whenever the topics of the universe and time travel come up. And I think you could be useful to us.
: You...intend to use me as a tool to fix the world?
: Right.
: Gotcha. I completely understand what the slumber party is for now and why it needs to be tonight instead of literally any other night.
: Well...we’re already together, aren’t we?
scene makotobeachthreemoons5
: We sleep in the same building on the same floor. Just wait until we’re not in the middle of vacation if you want to abuse my status as Sensei’s dream girl to try and fix your timeloop.
: You know he’s coming too, right? I just got off the phone with him a little while ago since he actually keeps his on him.
: Well, so would I if I was getting nudes from cute girls all day. What’s your point?
: My point is this is the perfect opportunity for you to get closer to him and try to bridge the gap between you and the older Maya he still cries about all the time.
: Bullshit. He can talk to me alone when he wants to do that. Why should I believe someone I’m competing against? Especially someone who competes as...viciously as you.
scene makotobeachthreemoons6
: There’s something you’re not telling me here. And I’m not about to go wandering into some room where you and a bunch of other girls can kill me just so you can climb up the rankings.
: I get not trusting me since the two of us aren’t particularly close. But you do trust Ayane, don’t you?
: Not really, no.
: Oh.
: Well, can you come anyway? Because this all sort of hinges on your involvement and I’ll have stayed up all night for nothing if you don’t come.
: No.
: Food will be provided.
: Fine.
: Wow. You’d be really easy to kidnap if I was an older man with ulterior motives. Is that how you fell into Sensei’s lap?
scene makotobeachthreemoons7
: I did not fall into his lap. He put me there. And it is there I have remained ever since — even in the face of time and a world that seems dedicated to tormenting me specifically.
: What’s all this about tormenting you?
scene makotobeachthreemoons8
: Oh, Ami. We were just-
: I’m not talking to you, Makoto. I’m talking to Maya. She’s not supposed to be here.
: Yasu told me the same thing. Why is everyone trying to get rid of me all of a sudden? I’ve literally just minded my own business all weekend.
: Is that the “torment” you were talking about? Or were you insinuating something else, maybe?
scene makotobeachthreemoons9
: Right. Well, I’m gonna go.
scene makotobeachthreemoons10
: Do you have to? Because I kind of don’t want to be alone with her.
: I have one other person to go round up. And hopefully they’ll be easier to track down. Just text me for more details in an hour or two if you change your mind about coming.
scene makotobeachthreemoons11
: Makoto, wait!
scene makotobeachthreemoons12
: Coming where? Did Makoto invite you to something?
: I...she...yeah. I’m not going, though.
: Why not?
: Just...sounds kind of sketchy. That’s all.
: That just makes it sound like you’re hiding something.
: Ami-
: Are you?...Hiding something, Maya?
: What? No! Of course not. I trust you way more than Makoto. I’ve only talked to her, like...three times. Max.
scene makotobeachthreemoons13
: Great! Then you and I can spend the whole night together while everyone else fights over my dad!
scene makotobeachthreemoons14
: Why the long face all of a sudden? Is there something wrong with what I said?
scene black
: Nothing at all.
scene makotobeachthreemoons15
Makoto Miyamura was swarmed by colored lights as she walked along the coastline! Colors that must mean something!
scene makotobeachthreemoons16
Until they don’t. And you realize it’s all just a trick of the camera. A prank on your perception, leading you astray from the words on the screen when all they’ve ever been is honest!
Just honesty comes in different forms. And while it may not take the shape of color or some other familiar distortion, it can still be monumental when wielded by the right hands.
But that begs to question — what about the left ones?
Which gods do the gods worship?
Makoto Miyamura. Beach.
scene makotobeachthreemoons17
Yumi Yamaguchi! Beach!
Why is it always the beach?! I’m still reeling from the last time and you expect me to just go on and on like it’s nothing?! Is this the perfect harmony you hoped for?!
scene makotobeachthreemoons17
No! Don’t cut me off! I’m still not-

scene makotobeachthreemoons17
: Oh, Prez. What are you doing out here for? Shouldn’t you be, like...studyin’ or some shit?
: That’s what you do for fun, right? I promise I ain’t tryin’ to be an asshole this time.
: Maybe a few years ago. I have new ideas of fun now. And tonight, you’re lucky enough to be involved in one.
scene makotobeachthreemoons18
: Yeah. So lucky. Been here for a total of thirty fuckin’ minutes and I’m already bein’ roped into somebody’s bullshit. Beats workin’ at least.
: Go on, then. Tell me. The fuck you want? Somethin’ to do with more apocalypse shit, I’m guessin’?
: Well, yeah. But how did you-
: Blondie had a god damn shirt shipped to my dorm room. You guys ain’t gonna make me wear it, are you?
: Only if you want to match us.
: Wow, yeah. Sounds fun. So, when’s this shit supposed to happen this time? We got time to, like...prepare and shit?
: Well...we don’t know. And we basically never know anymore now that the girl who was able to sense it is suddenly just a less useful version of herself.
: However, I think that if we’re able to get her back on board, we might be able to-
: This shit you need to tell me now? Or can it wait until we’re all in the same fuckin’ room? Want at least a few minutes of peace and quiet if that fits within your master plan.
: Oh. Yeah. I’m planning on going into greater detail later, so-
: Cool. Watch the water with me then?
: ...What?
: ‘Less you don’t wanna. Ain’t gonna break my heart or anything if you say no.
: You’re actually inviting me to join you? You’re not going to tell me to fuck off?
: I might if you start bein’ fuckin’ weird about it.
scene makotobeachthreemoons19
: I don’t have to be weird. In fact, I actually think this is a nice little moment of respite after an otherwise hectic day.
: Heard from Noriko that Futaba freaked the fuck out earlier and called out Sensei on bein’ a fuckin’ predator. Kinda pissed I missed it.
: Even that’s putting it lightly. She freaked out on practically everyone. And I get that she’s been going through some stuff, but...still. It was weird.
: Think she’s finally gettin’ tired of all this shit? Havin’ to compete with the whole fuckin’ class for the fake-ass love of some guy who doesn’t have any to give in the first place?
: Could be. I think we all get days like that sometimes. That...awareness, I mean. Just most of us keep it to ourselves.
: It does make you feel stupid when you think about it, though. I’m not really sure how things ended up like this.
: Guess I should be pretty proud of myself for bein’ the only girl around he ain’t porked yet then, huh?
: You’re not the only one. There are a few still hanging on for dear life. I imagine you will be the last if things keep going at this pace, though.
: That just makes it sound like it’s inevitable, don’t it?
: Not really. What’s inevitable is you giving into your feelings since I know you like him too.
scene makotobeachthreemoons20
: Don’t fuck with me, Four Eyes. You’re finally on my good side.
: I’m not trying to fuck with you, Yumi. You’ve really grown on me lately and I’m not trying to ruin that before we’re even friends.
: I just feel bad that even in the midst of a timeline that likely won’t ever end, you won’t let yourself enjoy it.
: Is that a loyalty thing? Or is your moral code just weirdly powerful when it comes to, uhh...chronologically imbalanced relationships?
: So me not likin’ him just ain’t even a possibility in your head, huh?
: No. I’m a little too smart for that, I think.
: Are you? Cause you weren’t smart enough to keep him outta your pants. You let him in the same way everyone else did, so you ain’t as special as you think.
scene makotobeachthreemoons19
: I didn’t do that because I’m dumb. I did it because I’m sad.
: Lots of sad girls ‘round here nowadays. And they’ve all got the same fuckin’ thing in common.
: Just trying to stay out of our ranks then, huh?
: Just trying to survive. Better chance of that if I ain’t got any weaknesses.
: Fair enough. I still think it’s inevitable, though. And honestly? I’d be interested to see what a Yumi in love would look like. Even if she were a rival of mine.
: She’d probably just look like another dumb bitch. Ain’t you seen enough of those by now?
: Do you think Noriko and Chika are dumb bitches, Yumi?
: Well...they’re dumb. And they’re bitches. Probably wouldn’t call ‘em dumb bitches, though. So maybe you’re onto something here?
: Yeah...maybe I am. And maybe one day, we’ll be able to talk like this without you holding yourself back.
: I wonder what that’d be like?
: Exhausting, probably.
: Yeah...probably.
: Punch me in the mouth if that ever happens, alright?
: I’ll try. I’m not much of a fighter, though.
: Yeah, and I ain’t much of a lover. So maybe we should just keep ourselves in line, then? I’ll figure out how to punch myself if I ever get soft.
: And I’ll continue fucking the guy you like. Works for me.
: Aight. Now you’re on my bad side again.
scene black
: Heh...
: It was only a matter of time...
